title: New bounds for the area of MOTS and generalized ultra-massive spacetimes
summary: Bounds for the area of general closed marginally trapped surfaces (MTSs) are presented. They do not require any stability condition, and are determined by a constant that depends on a particular component of the Einstein tensor on the surface and another constant that governs the (in)stability of the MTS. When stability is imposed, the area bounds are refined.
